description: This file defines the Payment controller class for the admin extension in OpenCart, providing methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling payment extensions. It handles loading language files, retrieving extension data, managing permissions, and rendering views related to payment extensions.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Controller class for managing payment extensions in the OpenCart admin area. Provides methods to list, install, and uninstall payment modules, handle permissions, and load necessary resources.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of available payment extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for listing all payment extensions, including installed and available ones.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a payment extension, including permissions, language, and auto-configuration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a payment extension, including permission checks and removal from the system.
